name: Secret Mask in the Mist
purpose: Hidden achievement art unlocked by clicking the hero's mask 50 times.
visual: Dark horned mask silhouette emerging from black mist with glowing crimson eye slit.
prompt: A minimalist 2D graphic illustration of a secret mystery. A shadowy horned samurai mask silhouette emerging from deep black darkness, with a single sharp glowing crimson-red eye slit, framed inside a subtle crimson circle, extreme negative space, clean vector art, no 3D, no text.
